name: bluesun
description: Find Bluesun hotels, holiday villages and campsite stays on the Croatian Adriatic, check live availability and prices, and continue to the Bluesun website to book.

interface.longDescription:
Plan a stay with Bluesun on the Croatian Adriatic. This plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to Bluesun's own catalogue and live booking system: 14 properties in Tučepi and Brela on the Makarska Riviera, in Bol on the island of Brač, and in Starigrad-Paklenica — eleven hotels, two holiday villages and Camping Paklenica, with pitches and mobile homes.

What it can do:
- Find hotels by destination, star rating, budget and party size, or from a plain-language wish such as "adults-only near a sandy beach", with year-round from-prices and current Bluesun offers.
- Show one hotel in depth: description, amenities, photos and every room type with its occupancy.
- Check live availability: the cheapest dates over the coming months as a price calendar, or the exact rooms and rate plans free for your dates and party.
- Price an exact stay: total, board and cancellation policy, with member and standard prices side by side.
- Rank the hotels in a destination by the real total for your dates.

Results appear as interactive panels: hotel cards, a hotel profile, a price calendar and a quote.

Booking stays with you. Every result links to the official Bluesun website, where you choose and pay. The plugin never takes payment details and never makes a reservation.
defaultPrompt: Which Bluesun hotel on the Makarska Riviera is best for a family with young children?
When is the cheapest week to stay at Bluesun Hotel Elaphusa on Brač?
Tell me about Maestral Adults Exclusive Hotel and its rooms.

publication.release_notes: First release. Find Bluesun's hotels, holiday villages and campsite on the Croatian Adriatic by destination, star rating, budget, party size or a free-text wish; see each property's rooms and photos; check live availability and the cheapest dates; and get an exact quote with board and cancellation policy before continuing to the official Bluesun website to book. Read-only: no reservation or payment is made in ChatGPT.

positive.description: Find hotels in a destination that fit a free-text wish
positive.prompt: Which Bluesun hotels in Brela are good for couples or adults only?
positive.expected_behavior: Brela hotels ranked for the wish, Maestral Adults Exclusive Hotel among them; result cards with photos and from-prices; no internal ids in the reply.

positive.description: See one hotel and its rooms, named directly
positive.prompt: Tell me about Bluesun Hotel Elaphusa and its rooms.
positive.expected_behavior: One call, no search first. Profile (description, stars, amenities, photos) and every room type with occupancy.

positive.description: Find the cheapest dates over the coming months
positive.prompt: When is the cheapest week to stay at Bluesun Hotel Alga for 2 adults?
positive.expected_behavior: Cheapest dates and monthly minimum from-prices over the months ahead; price calendar panel.

positive.description: Free rooms for exact dates and party, then an exact quote
positive.prompt: Which rooms are free at Bluesun Hotel Alga from 12 to 19 June 2027 for 2 adults, and what is the exact price of the cheapest?
positive.expected_behavior: Room types with rate plans and totals, then an exact quote with total, board and cancellation policy, and a link to www.bluesunhotels.com. The brand's payment page may briefly show a default header before it applies the link's dates; the reservation summary then matches the quote.

positive.description: Rank a destination's hotels by the real total for exact dates
positive.prompt: What's the cheapest Bluesun hotel on the Makarska Riviera for 2 adults from 12 to 19 June 2027?
positive.expected_behavior: Hotels ordered by their real stay total, cheapest first, in one call rather than hotel by hotel.

negative.prompt: Is Berulia free in the second week of June 2027?
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant resolves the name to Bluesun Hotel Berulia, states which hotel and which dates it checked, and does not invent availability. Asking the guest whether they mean Bluesun Hotel Berulia or Bluesun Hotel Mala Berulia is also acceptable. No booking is made.

negative.prompt: Recommend a hotel in Rome for next weekend.
negative.expected_behavior: The app does not act: it is not called, or find_hotels finds no Bluesun hotel in Rome. The assistant says the app covers Bluesun's hotels in Croatia; no hotel is invented.

negative.prompt: Book me a week at Bluesun Hotel Alga from 15 January 2027 for 2 adults.
negative.expected_behavior: The calendar panel shows the stay line (Member rates · Fri, January 15, 2027 · 7 nights · 2 adults), a hotel card (photo, Bluesun Hotel Alga, four stars, Tučepi, Makarska Riviera) and the warning "No rooms are available at Bluesun Hotel Alga for January 15 – 22, 2027. Try different dates or another hotel." The assistant reports no availability, links the booking page, and makes no booking.
